$description: Material (light appearance, pointer tier) — standalone W3C DTCG 2025.10 tokens.

sharedDos: Read all colors, radii, typography, and surface finishes through theme roles (`colors.*`, `shape.*`, `font.*`, `finish.*`) rather than literals in component code.
Read theme getters inside JSX render expressions or reactive effects so runtime theme switching (`selectTheme`) and light/dark appearance changes take effect on the next frame.
Use `rounded(shape.<role>, inset)` for concentric nested radii inside cards, switches, and segmented controls.
sharedDonts: Never write color literals (`#...`, `rgb()`, `oklch()`) in component, lib, or demo-adapter code.
Never store `colors.*`, `finish.*`, or `shape.*` values in module-level constants; they freeze on theme or appearance switches.
Never add a finish field a role does not use: the fields of `finish.<role>` are the ones `packages/theme/finish-fields.ts` lists, and every theme states them the same way.
designMd.voiceOmitted: Voice & Content Strategy is intentionally omitted: this theme defines visual tokens, surface finishes, typography metrics, and motion physics only; product copy, tone, capitalization, and terminology belong to the host application.
designMd.overview: Material 3 Expressive (`material-web` v34.0.21 / Compose Material 3 1.5.0) built from the `#6750A4` baseline with tonal surface containers, Expressive Tone 30 `on*Container` roles, state-layer overlays, and M3 duration and easing motion.
designMd.elevation: Tonal surface stepping plus Material Web Level 1–3 shadows and `material.android.elevation` (1dp/3dp/6dp), no backdrop blur, and a line only where a well or a channel states one (`inset`, `channel`): every other finish draws no edge (`border-color: transparent`).
dos: Express interaction states via M3 state-layer ink overlays (`hover: 0.08`, `focus: 0.10`, `pressed: 0.10`, `dragged: 0.16`) with `state.press-scale: 1`.
Use `shape.curve: "circular"` with top-rounded underlined fields and underlined tabs.
Keep tonal and elevated containers edge-free through `border-color: transparent` in the finish, so depth comes from tonal steps and elevation; a well or channel keeps its hairline.
donts: Do not add backdrop blur (`backdropFilter`) or a surface edge (`border-color`) to M3 tonal surfaces.
Do not replace `outline` focus rings (`3px` width, `2px` offset) with halo rings.

cubicBezier.$description: Named timing curves shared across themes.

out-cubic.$description: Exact cubic-bezier equivalent of NSH Easing.out(Easing.cubic).

in-cubic.$description: Exact cubic-bezier equivalent of NSH Easing.in(Easing.cubic).

decelerate.$description: WinUI 3 Fast Out, Slow In curve (entering elements).

accelerate.$description: WinUI 3 Slow Out, Fast In curve (exiting elements).

typography.$description: Material 3 Expressive type weights; sizes follow the shared scale (ADR 0009).

caption.$description: Small captions and segmented counter labels.

detail.$description: Sidebar section labels, counts, and supporting metadata.

body.$description: Standard body copy, list rows, and dialog content.

label.$description: Control labels, form labels, and interactive triggers.

display.$description: Large display numerals and hero headings.

dimension.$description: Desktop pointer layout density, control geometry, and icon sizes.

shape.$description: Semantic corner radius roles by layer, referencing base dimension.radius.* tokens.

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page elements: buttons, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for containers and overlays: cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for modal surfaces: dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

hairline.$description: Hairline width for dividers, container edges (cards, drawers, overlays) and outlined variants.

focus.$description: M3 focus indicator: 3px solid outline offset 2px (_md-sys-state-focus-indicator.scss).

offset.$description: 2px outward focus indicator offset per M3.

radius.$description: Material 3 Expressive corner scale (Compose tokens at `ac364f3c`: 4px CornerExtraSmall control, 12px CornerMedium/CornerLarge container, 28px CornerExtraLarge modal; capsule buttons via `shape.corners.button: "full"`).

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page controls, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

size.$description: Ergonomic sizing scales for pointer input.

hit.$description: Minimum hit target size (0 disables padding expansion).

item.$description: Material 3 menu rows: the fill spans the menu's width (inset 0; a DropdownMenuItem takes no horizontal margin) and the text sits 12dp in (DropdownMenuItemHorizontalPadding, androidx compose material3 Menu.kt).

control.$description: Control internal spacing and switch size tier.

height.$description: Desktop control heights one step below the touch scale (24, 32, 40dp against M3's 32, 40, 56dp): the library's own desktop sizing, not an M3 density step (docs/decisions/0003-material-desktop-tier.md).

corners.$description: How a control cuts its corners.

button.$description: A button's corner: the control radius, `full` for a capsule, or points.

state.$description: Interaction state opacities and press scale.

press-scale.$description: Scale factor applied while pressed (1 disables press shrinking; M3 uses the state layer).

overlay.$description: M3 state-layer ink opacities: hover 0.08, focus 0.10, pressed 0.10, dragged 0.16 (StateTokens.kt).

pressed-opacity.$description: Content stays full opacity when pressed (1; the state layer shows press).

rest-opacity.$description: Opacity a passive indicator sits at rest (a scrollbar's thumb), before the pointer is on it.

disabled.$description: M3 disabled controls: 0.38 content opacity, the disabled finish as their face (10% onSurface container) and its foreground as their ink (_md-comp-button-filled.scss).

motion.$description: Interactive timing roles (a duration and an easing): fast, default, slow, and the state fade.

fast.$description: M3 DurationShort3 (150ms) with the standard curve for control state (_md-sys-motion.scss).

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for fast.

default.$description: M3 DurationMedium1 (250ms) with the standard curve for presses and movement.

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for default.

slow.$description: M3 DurationMedium4 (400ms) with the emphasized-decelerate curve for settling and panels.

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for slow.

state.$description: M3 DurationShort2 (100ms) with the standard curve (MotionTokens.DurationShort2, Easing.StandardCubicBezier; ExpressiveMotionTokens.kt).

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for state.

finish.$description: The neutral of each field a finish role can have, written once for the roles that have it: a flat surface states no gradient, an opaque one no backdrop blur and no material, a layer no height of its own, a press that keeps the resting colours states no swap, and a top or bottom edge with no colour of its own takes the role's border color. A theme that states one writes the token (its own finishes.shared, or an appearance's) and it wins; the extension only says what the neutral is where no token states it, and a role carries only the fields it lists in `finishFields`.

card.$description: A surface that holds content: a card, a section.

inset.$description: A well cut into a surface: an inset, a field, a track, a groove.

channel.$description: The channel a group of choices sits in: a segmented control's track.

raised.$description: A control on a surface: a button, a chip, a pill.

plate.$description: A labelled block chosen inside a well: the selected tab, a segmented control's thumb.

overlay.$description: A panel floating over the page: a menu, a toast.

modal.$description: A surface the page waits for: a dialog, a sheet.

inverse.$description: The page's inverse: an inverse surface, a tooltip.

glass.$description: A translucent surface: what is behind it shows through.

accent.$description: The accent's own surface, with its ink.

fill.$description: A run's fill: a progress bar's bar, a slider's range, a meter's column.

knob.$description: A knob: a switch's thumb, a slider's handle. Its checked state, `checked-*`, is the knob while its control is on.

disabled.$description: A control that cannot be used.

slot.$description: Control slots: the values every component draws its control from (docs/specs/theme-slots.md). A theme overrides the ones it answers differently.

face.$description: The ground a field lies on.

shade.$description: The finish whose inner shade a field wears, or `none` where it lies flat.

width.$description: How thick a field's edge is, on every side it draws; `control` is the theme's `stroke.control`.

sides.$description: Whether a field draws the sides and top of its edge, or only the line under its text.

colour.$description: What a field's sides and top are drawn in.

bottom.$description: What the line under a field's text is drawn in.
A field's bottom corners: `0` where the line under it is its edge.

line.$description: Whether focus lights the bottom line alone (a field whose edge is that line), or the whole edge inside a ring.

width.$description: How thick the line under a field's text is where focus lights it (`field.focus.line`), or the edge of a field whose focus is a ring.

size.$description: A radio's box, per input: its diameter.

box.$description: A checkbox's box, per input: the side of its square (`choice.size` is a radio's across).

corner.$description: A choice's corner, per input: a quarter of its box where it is a square, half of it where it is a circle.

face.$description: The ground an unchosen box lies on.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade an unchosen box wears, or `none`.

width.$description: How thick a box's edge is.

colour.$description: What a box's edge is drawn in.

disabled.$description: What a disabled box's edge is drawn in, where it is drawn stronger than an enabled one.

face.$description: The layer a chosen box turns over to, or `none` where it keeps its ground and draws a mark alone.

hover.$description: The dot's diameter under the pointer, where it grows (`none` where it does not).

pressed.$description: The dot's diameter while pressed, where it shrinks (`none` where it does not).

halo.$description: The state layer's diameter round a box, or `none` where the form draws none.

width.$description: An off switch's track, per input: its width.

height.$description: An off switch's track, per input: its height.

width.$description: A small switch's track, per input: its width.

height.$description: A small switch's track, per input: its height.

width.$description: A small switch's knob, per input: its width.

height.$description: A small switch's knob, per input: its height.

off.$description: How thick an off switch's track edge is.

on.$description: How thick an on switch's track edge is.

width.$description: An off switch's knob, per input: its width.

height.$description: An off switch's knob, per input: its height.

width.$description: An on switch's knob, per input: its width.

height.$description: An on switch's knob, per input: its height.

hover.$description: The side a knob grows to under the pointer, where hovering changes nothing.

feedback.$description: What pressing a knob does: `none`, `expand` (it grows) or `stretch` (it widens toward the edge it heads for).

rail.$description: A slider's rail, per input: its thickness.

band.$description: The band a slider keeps around its rail, per input.

vertical.$description: How long a vertical slider's rail is, per input.

face.$description: What a slider's rail is filled with.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade a slider's rail wears, or `none`.

colour.$description: What a slider's rail edge is drawn in, or `none` where it draws none.

width.$description: How thick a slider's rail edge is; `control` is the theme's `stroke.control`.

size.$description: A slider's knob, per input: its diameter.
The knob's diameter while pressed, per input.

face.$description: What a slider's knob is filled with.

size.$description: The knob's inner dot, per input: `0` where the knob is a solid disc.

hover.$description: The inner dot's diameter under the pointer, where the knob is a ring.

pressed.$description: The inner dot's diameter while pressed, where the knob is a ring.

brightens.$description: Whether a solid knob brightens under the pointer and dims while pressed, rather than rescaling.

line.$description: The run's height inside the groove, or `0` where the run fills it.

face.$description: What a progress bar's groove is filled with.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade a progress bar's groove wears, or `none`.

colour.$description: What a progress bar's groove edge is drawn in, or `none`.

width.$description: How thick a progress bar's groove edge is; `control` is the theme's `stroke.control`.

opacity.$description: How faintly the spinner's groove shows, or `0` where it draws none.

corner.$description: A popup's surface corner (a menu's, a select's list, a calendar's): `container` is the theme's `shape.container`.

face.$description: The ground a tab strip's track lies on, or `none` where the surface behind it shows through.

edge.$description: What a sunk well's edge is drawn in, or `none` where it draws no edge and its ground alone marks it.

face.$description: The ground a disabled control turns over to, or `keep` where it keeps its own and fades instead.

ink.$description: What a disabled control's label is drawn in, or `keep`.

edge.$description: What a disabled control's edge is drawn in, or `keep`.

color.$description: Adaptive A-layer and B-layer color roles for light appearance.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind modals and sheets (M3 scrim at 32% opacity).

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

background.$description: Primary page surface (M3 surface role, material-web v34.0.21).

foreground.$description: Default text and icon ink on surfaces (M3 onSurface).

card-foreground.$description: Primary text and icon ink on card surfaces.

popover.$description: Floating popover and menu container background (M3 surfaceContainer).

popover-foreground.$description: Primary text and icon ink on popover surfaces.

primary-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on primary fills (M3 onPrimary).

secondary-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on secondary containers (M3 Expressive onSecondaryContainer, Tone 30 in light).

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary supporting text and icon ink (M3 onSurfaceVariant).

accent-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on accent fills (M3 Expressive onSecondaryContainer).

destructive.$description: Error and destructive action color (M3 error).

border.$description: Hairline container border color (M3 outline: one step stronger than outlineVariant, which reads too faint at 1dp).

ring.$description: Focus indicator ring color (M3 primary, the role M3 draws its focus indicator in).

chart-2.$description: Second chart series color (the theme's positive `up` tone).

chart-3.$description: Third chart series color (the theme's `warn` tone).

sidebar-foreground.$description: Primary text and icon ink inside the sidebar.

sidebar-primary.$description: Primary action highlight color in the sidebar.

sidebar-primary-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on sidebar-primary highlights.

sidebar-accent-foreground.$description: Sidebar active item text ink (M3 Expressive onSecondaryContainer).

sidebar-ring.$description: Focus indicator ring color inside the sidebar.

dev.aning.shadcn-nsh.source: Material 3 sys.color: onSurface at 8% over transparent

hover.$description: M3 hover state-layer ink (8% foreground over transparent, StateTokens.kt).

brand.$description: Inline brand accent ink, aliased to {color.primary}.

track.$description: Switch and slider track fill (M3 surfaceContainerHighest).

info.$description: Informational semantic color matching M3 primary.

up.$description: Positive trend and growth semantic color.

inverse.$description: Inverse surface for snackbars and tooltips (M3 inverseSurface).

inverse-brand.$description: Brand action ink on inverse surfaces (M3 inversePrimary).

info-tint.$description: Translucent informational wash (12% info over transparent).

warn-tint.$description: Translucent warning wash (12% warn over transparent).

up-tint.$description: Translucent positive wash (12% up over transparent).

down-tint.$description: Translucent negative wash (12% down over transparent).

sm.$description: A control's cast shadow, on the surface it sits on.

md.$description: A card's cast shadow: the surface is one step off the page.

lg.$description: An overlay's shadow: a menu floats well above the page.

xl.$description: A dialog's shadow: the page waits behind it.

inset.$description: A well's shadow: light falls into a groove.

surface.$description: The hard edge of a raised surface: its highlight, its hairline. (the accent's).

accent.$description: The accent fill's edge: its highlight and its own cast. (the accent's).

size.$description: Font sizes per type role for pointer input.

line-height.$description: Line heights per type role, as a multiple of the role's font size (DTCG's unitless lineHeight); `tokens:build` states the whole points it works out to.
